parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description:
The name of the application.

> To trigger origin fetch for all applications, set this parameter to **ali\_all\_app**.

parameters.name: PullAppName
parameters.description:
The source application name.

> Leave this parameter empty to use the application name from the playback URL of the source stream.

parameters.name: PullDomainName
parameters.description: The origin server that hosts the live stream. To specify multiple origin servers, separate them with semicolons (;).

parameters.name: PullProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol to use for pulling the stream from the source. Valid values:

- **rtmp**

- **httpflv**

- **hls**

parameters.name: TranscodeLazy
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to trigger stream pulling when a request for a transcoded stream is made. Default value: **no**. Valid values:

- **yes**

- **no**
